# RPGGame v3.7.0 — windows-x64

Run `RPGGame-v3.7.0-windows-x64.exe` from this directory. Keep `content/` and any DLLs alongside it.
Saves use `savegame.dat` in the working directory. Back up saves before replacing the game.
Requires Windows 10/11 with standard system libraries.
Set `NO_COLOR=1` for plain output. SHA256SUMS covers all package payload files.
For source code and releases, visit https://github.com/asffxx/RPGGame.
